INTI International University
Diploma in Information Technology
DIT2213 Mobile Application Development - Group Project

Tasks and weightage
• Wireframes and UI design (20%)
• Android app development (50%)
• Final presentation (20%)
• Meeting minutes (10%)

Marking rubric
Criteria                   Weight   Excellent (4)       Good (3)       Poor (1)
Wireframes and UI design   20%      Clear, complete     Minor gaps     Missing screens
Android app development    50%      All features work   Some bugs      Does not run
Final presentation         20%      Confident           Reads slides   Unprepared
Meeting minutes            10%      Every meeting       Some           None
Total                      100%
